lines.beaver_en: Hello. Today I'd like to ask about the industry situation.
lines.en: Yes, nice to meet you. Overall, things are difficult.

lines.beaver_en: How about steel and heavy industry?
lines.en: Not only steel but also heavy industry has lost productivity.

lines.learner: 원자재 가격이 올라서 원료 수입이 힘듭니다.
lines.en: Raw material prices rose, so importing them is hard.
lines.roman: wonjajae gagyeogi ollaseo wollyo suibi himdeumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Are there companies that went bankrupt?
lines.learner: 네, 작은 기업체 몇 곳이 부도가 났습니다.
lines.en: Yes, a few small companies went bankrupt.
lines.roman: ne, jageun gieopche myeot gosi budoga natseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: How about the transportation of goods?
lines.en: Shipping costs rose, so manufactured goods got pricier.

lines.learner: 다국적 기업이 시장을 거의 독점하고 있습니다.
lines.en: Multinational companies almost monopolize the market.
lines.roman: dagukjeok gieobi sijangeul geoui dokjeomhago itseumnida.

lines.learner: 점유율이 낮아서 업소 문을 닫는 업자가 많습니다.
lines.en: Their market share is low, so many close their shops.
lines.roman: jeomyuyuri najaseo eopso muneul danneun eopjaga manseumnida.

lines.learner: 어업과 농업은 물론, 석탄 채굴도 힘듭니다.
lines.en: Fishing and farming, and even coal mining, are struggling.
lines.roman: eoeopgwa nongeobeun mullon, seoktan chaeguldo himdeumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Are there any fields doing well?
lines.learner: 금융업은 번창하고 있고, 철거 사업도 늘었습니다.
lines.en: Finance is flourishing, and demolition work has grown.
lines.roman: geumyungeobeun beonchanghago itgo, cheolgeo saeopdo neureotseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Lastly, could you share your outlook?
lines.en: It will gradually get better. Thank you.
